title: DiscoveryRecord
description: Authoritative field-level payload schema for the DiscoveryRecord family of UCOS-DATA-CONTRACT-027 (API-027 Registry, GET /registry/discovery?type=). A DiscoveryRecord is one entry of the discovery index (LDO-061 / PDE-061 Discovery Index) identifying an artifact discoverable by type. Field authority: UCOS-PDATA-ARCH-001. Fields are derived from the Registry substrate (RegistryPort resolve/list) and API-027 discovery operation intent. Wiring/endpoint/transport is deliberately NOT modeled here (owned by Prompt 08); security controls deferred to Prompt 09.

schema.description: One discovery-index entry. Realizes LDO-061 Discovery Index / PDE-061.
Discovery type filter selecting which wiring/services are discovered. Source authority: API-027 GET /registry/discovery?type= (UCOS-CONTRACT-CAT-001 §A).
Identifier of the discovered artifact. Source authority: RegistryRecord.id (the discovery index projects registered artifacts).
Semantic version of the discovered artifact, when resolved to a concrete version. Source authority: RegistryRecord.version (SemVer).
Kind of the discovered artifact. Source authority: RegistryRecord.kind (meta-core/ports.ts).
